name: Gillette
verdict: Owned by The Procter & Gamble Company. Amnesty International's 2016 investigation found child and forced labour in Indonesian palm-oil plantations it traced to P&G's supply chain.

why.text: Gillette is owned by The Procter & Gamble Company. An Amnesty International investigation found child and forced labour on Indonesian palm-oil plantations that P&G is highly likely to source from.
